detail.longDescription: Sayrud is an open-source, self-hosted collaborative spreadsheet with grid, kanban, gallery and form views. It supports real-time collaboration, formulas and SSO with your existing IdP. Custom JavaScript field shortcuts can connect to models like TypeSafe's Jev to classify field values. Runs with Docker Compose. AGPL-3.0. Website: https://sayrud.com Demo: https://try.sayrud.com (GitHub sign-in required) GitHub: https://github.com/sayrud/sayrud
